question: LAPTOP FDV above $1B one day after launch?
resolution_criteria:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the Fully Diluted Valuation of the LAPTOP token is greater than the specified value 1 day after launch. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

The token referenced in this market is LAPTOP, the token announced by Hunter Biden for launch on Base, as identified by the token's official channels (https://x.com/Laptoptoken) and confirmed by Hunter Biden or his official representatives.

The token must be actively and publicly tradable to be considered a launch.

The FDV will be determined using the total token supply multiplied by the token price.

"1 day after launch" is defined as 4:00 PM ET on the calendar day following launch. The resolution source for this market is the most liquid price source available. If the LAPTOP token has not launched by December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "No".
research:
I'm writing up the findings now. Most page fetches were blocked, so the facts below come from search-result summaries. I left out everything dated after 2026-09-09, including later price snapshots.

## 1. Resolution source
- The criteria name the "most liquid price source available" and the official channel [x.com/Laptoptoken](https://x.com/Laptoptoken). I couldn't fetch the X account. One report says the coin's X account was suspended after the crash and that Hunter Biden said the foundation was working to restore it. [coingabbar](https://www.coingabbar.com/en/crypto-currency-news/hunter-biden-laptop-coin-price-crash-x-account-suspend-news)
- The Base contract appears to be 0xb2000000000000000000007f14e95d2c1da33356 ([Coinbase price page](https://www.coinbase.com/price/laptop-base-0xb2000000000000000000007f14e95d2c1da33356-token)). Trackers include [CoinGecko](https://www.coingecko.com/en/coins/hunter-bidens-laptop) and [CryptoRank](https://cryptorank.io/price/laptop-base). Some "LAPTOP" listings on Robinhood-chain contracts are different tokens.
- Total supply is 1B, so the $1B line works out to about $1.00 per token. CryptoSlate/CMC lists a maximum supply of 985M instead, which would put the line nearer $1.015. [onebullex](https://www.onebullex.com/news/articles/hunter-biden-s-laptop-token-launches-on-base-with-1b-supply-and-muted-first-week-demand), [cryptoslate](https://cryptoslate.com/coins/hunter-bidens-laptop/)
- I couldn't get a live reading from the source.

## 2. Current status
- 2026-09-09: LAPTOP went live and became publicly tradable on Base. That makes the measurement time 4:00 PM ET on 2026-09-10. [qz](https://qz.com/hunter-biden-laptop-memecoin-crash-debut-090926)
- 2026-09-09, latest same-day figures: CoinMarketCap showed about $0.84, an FDV of roughly $835M. [coingape](https://coingape.com/prediction-markets/will-laptop-meme-coin-hold-a-100m-fdv-one-day-after-launch-odds-reach-96/) A CoinGecko figure put it near $0.77, with a market cap of about $275M on circulating supply, which implies an FDV around $770M.
- **Bottom line:** the latest price I found is below $1B FDV, though not far below. Nothing settles the question yet.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-09: According to Arkham and BaseScan data, a LAPTOP multisig received 100M tokens before launch and has distributed about 42.5M. Market maker GSR received 15.5M four days before the open and has been distributing them. This comes from a single report. [kucoin](https://www.kucoin.com/news/flash/hunter-biden-s-laptop-token-drops-98-after-1-6b-debut-on-base)
- 2026-09-09: Biden blamed thin liquidity for the volatility, said the price had "stabilized to healthy levels," and said the project would continue. [ground.news](https://ground.news/daily-briefing/hunter-bidens-laptop-token-spikes-then-crashes_cfa2c5)
- 2026-09-09: The price spiked to $190.81 about two minutes after the open, an FDV near $144B against a $48K liquidity pool, then fell to $3.70 within an hour. Reported lows were around $0.72. CoinDesk's headline cites a $1.6B debut market cap. [CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/business/2026/09/09/hunter-biden-s-laptop-memecoin-debuts-at-usd1-6-billion-market-cap), [Breitbart](https://www.breitbart.com/tech/2026/09/09/hunter-biden-launches-laptop-meme-cryptocurrency-to-cash-in-on-2020-election-scandal/)
- 2026-09-07: Biden announced the token. Founders hold 30% under a 6-month lockup. Another 20% goes to airdrops for people who lost money on TRUMP and to his Substack subscribers. [CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/business/2026/09/07/hunter-biden-is-launching-a-memecoin-named-after-his-laptop), [Fox Business](https://www.foxbusiness.com/politics/hunter-biden-launching-laptop-themed-cryptocurrency)

## 4. Base rates
- I didn't find a systematic base rate for celebrity or political memecoins holding a given FDV after one day. Launches like this often lose most of their peak value within 24 hours, and LAPTOP had already dropped more than 99% from its peak on day one.
- The swings here are very large. Within hours the price ranged from $0.72 to above $3, so a 20-30% move in 24 hours (from about $0.80 to above $1.00) is well within what this token has already done.
- 2026-09-07 to 09-09: after launch, reporting described weak demand and a frenzy that didn't materialize. [onebullex](https://www.onebullex.com/news/articles/hunter-biden-s-laptop-token-launches-on-base-with-1b-supply-and-muted-first-week-demand)

## 5. Other forecasts
- Before launch, Polymarket gave the $1B line 8-12%, the $250M line 45%, and the $100M line 72-80%. [KuCoin](https://www.kucoin.com/news/flash/market-predicts-laptop-meme-coin-s-first-day-fdv-between-100m-and-250m), [X post](https://x.com/wiseadvicesumit/status/2097581761484259624)
- 2026-09-09: the $1B contract rose to about 36% YES, up roughly 24 points after the debut. [Tech Insider](https://tech-insider.org/hunter-biden-laptop-fdv-1b-polymarket-odds/)
- Around 2026-09-09, the $100M line was about 96%. [coingape](https://coingape.com/prediction-markets/will-laptop-meme-coin-hold-a-100m-fdv-one-day-after-launch-odds-reach-96/)
- Event page: [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/laptop-fdv-above-one-day-after-launch). I couldn't load the live price.
- I found nothing on Kalshi or Manifold.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- The measurement is at 4:00 PM ET on 2026-09-10.
- Continued selling by the project multisig and GSR would push the price down.
- Restoring the suspended X account, any new exchange listings, or the airdrop distribution (claims plus selling by recipients) could move the price either way.
- Liquidity is thin, so a single large trade could push FDV across $1B in either direction near the measurement time.
- The "most liquid source" wording and the 1B vs 985M supply question could matter if the price ends up close to $1.00.
